Delta Reign

Released November 6, 2026 · 141 cards

StandardExpanded

Delta Reign is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Mega Evolution series, released in English on November 6, 2026. Its main set has 103 cards, plus 38 secret rares numbered beyond the set (141 in total). It includes 114 Pokémon, 24 Trainer and 3 Energy cards, and is legal in the Standard and Expanded formats.
